candidate_physics_task.description: Fix the palm, drive the five tendon winders and thumb-abduction servo, and close around cylinders of several diameters. intended_articulation.count_excludes: Motor internals, spool shaft coordinates, CAD mate mirror objects and fixed fasteners.
intended_articulation.coupling: Each three-joint finger has one tendon actuator. Contact and elastic returns determine sequential phalanx motion; those joints are not independently controlled.
intended_articulation.drive: Five DC gearmotors wind one tendon per digit; one RC servo actuates thumb abduction/adduction. Elastic joint returns extend the fingers.
intended_articulation.evidence_type: Author-stated intended hand DOFs, consistent with assembly component names; not a kinematic solver result.

reasons: Native CAD mates and absolute import paths encode design assembly relationships, not a simulator joint/link tree.
No URDF, Xacro, MJCF, SDF, USD physics asset or other standalone XML simulator description is present in the complete source snapshot.
No rigid-body masses/inertias, contacts, collision proxies, joint limits, motor drives or tendon dynamics are supplied by the inspected CAD properties.
Tendon/elastic routing and force laws require modeling; CAD part placement alone does not specify underactuated contact behavior.
Top-level subassembly caches are shell compounds, and the thumb abductor cache has 50 faces versus 51 in the separate source part.

source.author: Alvaro Villoslada (Alvipe / alvipe)
source.originality: Author-authored FreeCAD manufacturing/design source and authored companion STL exports. No simulator input was stripped or used to generate this source.

structure.cached_subassembly_caveat: Five top-level imported subassemblies have compound/shell cached geometry rather than solid records. The separate finger/thumb module files retain component solid records and original mate information. No healing or solid reconstruction was attempted.
structure.interpretation: 39 is the recursively expanded CAD leaf occurrence count, including fixed hardware; 15 unique leaf source documents. 467 includes feature history. 37 CAD mates (74 with mirrored proxy records) are not 37 physical joints.

title: Dextra: original 15-joint tendon-driven robotic hand
uncertainties: Exact articulation axes, ranges, reference poses and mimic/coupling relations are not supplied as physical joints; CAD mates provide evidence, not final dynamics.
Tendon routing through channels, slack, compliance, pulley radius under winding, friction and elastic return constants require independent modeling or measurement.
Mass, density, inertia, motor torque/speed, gear backlash and contact friction are uncalibrated. Hardware firmware gains are not a validated dynamics model.
Published assembly caches and separately updated parts are not perfectly synchronized: thumb abductor face count differs (50 cached / 51 source). No repair was performed.
Absolute imports, the historical winder filename and an unrecorded Assembly2 addon version may complicate later recomputation; original BReps, placements and part dependencies are retained.
Repository licensing is explicit, but native license metadata and the separate origin of commercial component CAD should be reconciled before downstream redistribution decisions.
No CAD-kernel validity, watertightness, interference, geometric equivalence, volume, bounding-box or simulation checks were performed.
